name: a-replay-says-it-already-ran
description: SPEC.md 4.9 (v1.14): a replayed outcome reaches the Brain whole, followed by a note saying the act already ran in this run with these arguments. Handed back bare, a replay reads as a fresh answer to a fresh ask, and a model that asked because it did not have what it wanted asks again. The tool still runs once.

expect.brainSees: already ran in this run with the same arguments
